text: ぼくは　つかまえに　つかまえて　つかれて　しまったよ

structure.jp: つかまえに　つかまえて
つかれて　しまったよ

patterns.name: 〜に〜て
patterns.span: つかまえに　つかまえて
patterns.explanation: Saying the same verb twice with に in between means doing it again and again, a great deal. つかまえに つかまえて = 'I caught and caught, and'.

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.span: つかれて　しまった
patterns.explanation: てしまう after a verb says the thing happened completely, often to your regret. つかれて しまった = 'I've gone and worn myself out'.
